design:
Tier 1: a read-only route parameter and UI wiring; no migration, no Hub-restart or live-data hazard.

Decisions (operator-approved 2026-11-14 where marked, otherwise the author's):
- The look is the approved mock (operator, 2026-11-14): hub/ui/mock route #conversation/Architect/conv-9cdda4865e0b/files, components FilesTab and LocationSwitch in hub/ui/src/components/panel.
- Opens on the checkout and remembers the last choice per conversation (operator, 2026-11-14).
- The checkout is resolved exactly as the Changes route resolves its branch (hub/hub/api/v1/changes.py:119-146, _resolve_target), so the two tabs can never disagree. The resolution is read-only: it uses the lookup that provisions nothing (worktrees.existing_worktree, hub/hub/worktrees.py:545), never resolve_agent_workspace, which creates a worktree as a side effect of browsing.
- The worktree listing and read apply the root's rules and guards unchanged (hub/hub/workspace_paths.py:21-70, hub/hub/workspace_file.py): listing membership is the traversal guard, links out are refused, 1 MB limit, NUL-sniff binary. The agent is named by the conversation, never by a path in the request.
- The changed marks come from the same computation as the Changes tab's Since main, not a second one.
- The container follows ChangesTabContainer/ChangesTab; FilePreview is reused for highlighting and Markdown.
- A file tab's identity includes its location, so the panel store's file: ids carry it.

problem: The operator, 2026-11-12: the Files tab is "so so". Today it is a flat "Search files by path" box (hub/ui/src/components/spec/FilesIndexTab.tsx:26, mounted at hub/ui/src/components/agents/ConversationView.tsx:395-403) that lists nothing until you type. It lists only the project's registered directory: GET /workspace/paths and GET /workspace/file (hub/hub/api/v1/workspace.py:30, :46) resolve the project root and take no agent or checkout. So the files an agent is creating in its own worktree, which is where every writing agent works, cannot be seen from the panel. The Changes tab (slice changes-view, shipped 2026-11-13) shows the agent's diffs but not the whole files around them. A presentational tree with a Worktree/Project root switch, changed marks and a "Changed only" filter already exists, unwired (hub/ui/src/components/panel/FilesTab.tsx:28, LocationSwitch.tsx:7), shown in the mock at mock.html#conversation/Architect/conv-9cdda4865e0b/files, which the operator approved on 2026-11-14. The preview already highlights about 26 languages and renders Markdown (hub/ui/src/components/spec/FilePreview.tsx:4-45, :118).

requirements.rationale: Two tabs side by side that disagree on which checkout is 'the agent's' would show a diff of one tree and the files of another.
requirements.statement: When the conversation's agent has a checkout of its own, the Files tab offers a switch between that checkout and the project root, and the tab names which one it is showing; the checkout is the one the Changes tab shows for the same conversation (the task checkout when the agent is working or last worked a task, otherwise the agent's own worktree).

requirements.rationale: Operator, 2026-11-14: the checkout is where the agent is working, so it is the useful default; a choice made on purpose should stick.
requirements.statement: When the agent has a checkout, the Files tab first opens on it; after the operator switches location, the tab reopens on the location last chosen for that conversation, including after a page reload, while other conversations keep their own choice.

When the agent has no checkout of its own (a read-only agent, or one whose worktree has not been created), the tab offers no switch, shows the project root, and says the agent works in the project directory or has no checkout yet; it never shows an empty tree or an error code for that reason.

With the checkout chosen, the tab lists that checkout's files under the same rules as the project root (tracked files plus untracked files git does not ignore), as a collapsible tree with a find box, including a file the agent created and has not committed.

requirements.rationale: The worktree read must not become a way round the guards the root read already has.
requirements.statement: Opening a file reads it from the location it was listed in; a request naming a path the chosen location does not list, a path escaping it through a link, or another project's or another agent's checkout is refused, and files over 1 MB and binary files are handled as the project-root preview handles them today.

In the checkout, every file the agent changed on its branch since main is marked added, modified or deleted (a deleted file still listed, struck through), and a Changed only switch narrows the tree to those files; the set equals the Changes tab's Since main list for the same conversation.

An opened code file shows syntax-highlighted and an opened Markdown file shows rendered, legibly in both the light and dark themes, and the file's tab names its path and whether it came from the checkout or the project root; the same path opened from both locations opens two distinct tabs.
Insert into composer works for a file opened from either location and inserts its path relative to that location.
When a turn of the agent ends, an open Files tab showing its checkout lists any file that turn created, and updates its changed marks, within 5 seconds and without a reload.

in_scope: The Files tab shows a collapsible tree of the chosen location's files, with a find box, in the overhauled panel style of the approved mock
A switch between the conversation agent's checkout and the project root, the checkout chosen exactly as the Changes tab chooses its branch
Opening on the checkout, and remembering the operator's choice per conversation
Files the agent changed on that branch marked added, modified or deleted, and a Changed only filter
Opening a file from either location, highlighted or rendered, saying which location it came from
Insert into composer from either location
The tree following the agent: a file its turn created appears without a reload
non_goals: Any change to the Specs, Changes or Running tabs
Editing, creating, renaming or deleting files from the panel
Browsing another agent's checkout (the peer-conversation slice watches peers)
Browsing files git ignores, or files outside the chosen checkout
A picker across the agent's past task checkouts
The terminal (terminal-tab slice), which reuses this slice's location choice
Raising the 1 MB preview limit or previewing binary files

summary: The conversation side panel's Files tab becomes a browsable tree in the overhauled style, with a switch between the conversation agent's checkout and the project root. Files the agent changed are marked and can be filtered to, and opening a file shows it highlighted (code) or rendered (Markdown) in both themes. A file the agent created a moment ago in its worktree can be found and read without leaving the conversation.
